record.title: Unconsented Cross-Project Roster Attachment via Imports Discloses Full Account Profile, Unqueried Contact Channel, Devices, and Global Security Event Log
record.description: A project_pi or project-scope data_manager can unilaterally attach any active user on the platform (including platform admins, PIs of other projects, and mentoring-institute scientists) to their project roster without target consent or admin approval via two import paths: (1) uploading a single-channel (email-only or mobile-only) CSV/XLSX to POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/members/import (prepare_members and apply_members in app/services/project_user_import_service.py:645-791), which inserts a MapProjectMember row, or (2) a project_pi uploading a workers sheet to POST /admin/api/organization/<project_id>/import (_import_workers in app/services/organization_service.py:2598-2663), which passes user_email directly to create_worker/update_worker -> resolve_user (accepting either a user_id UUID from masked search results or an email address at lines 1831-1833) while omitting the require_on_project_roster guard enforced on POST/PATCH /admin/api/organization/<project_id>/workers (app/routes/admin_organization.py:755, 860). Once attached to MapProjectMember or MasOrgUnitWorker, on_project_roster (app/services/organization_service.py:3956-3970) evaluates to True for that user in the attacker's project. This unlocks GET /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/<target_user_id> (admin_project_user_panel at app/routes/admin_organization.py:1558-1603) and GET /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid (get_project_users_grid at app/services/organization_service.py:4490-4530), disclosing the target user's unqueried or previously masked contact channel (bypassing lookup_existing_user at organization_service.py:3116-3118 and _dm_user_json masking at app/routes/data_management.py:224-233), demographics (year_of_birth, age, sex), all live enrolled mobile devices across all projects via list_account_devices (bypassing the all-grants coverage check in _device_management_user at app/services/user_directory_service.py:488-520), and up to 100 global AuthSecurityEvent records across all projects including cross-project actor names (_panel_activity at app/routes/admin_organization.py:1521-1541).
record.claimed_root_cause: _import_workers (app/services/organization_service.py:2598-2663) omits require_on_project_roster and allows resolving arbitrary active users by UUID or email via resolve_user (lines 1816-1838), while prepare_members/apply_members (app/services/project_user_import_service.py:645-791) allows a project_pi or project-scope data_manager to attach any active platform account to MapProjectMember using a single identifier; subsequently, admin_project_user_panel (app/routes/admin_organization.py:1558-1603) gates full contact disclosure, cross-project device inventory (list_account_devices), and unfiltered global security event history (_panel_activity at lines 1521-1541) solely on on_project_roster (app/services/organization_service.py:3956-3970) rather than requiring exclusive account management (may_edit_account / _device_management_user) or scoping security events to the project.

trace.description: Accepts a multipart CSV/XLSX upload from a project_pi or project-scope data_manager on POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/members/import (or via admin_org_import at line 1123 on POST /admin/api/organization/<project_id>/import).

Matches any active VaUsers account globally by email alone or mobile_login alone when the other field is left blank in the uploaded row (lines 715-729), marking the row action as add_existing (line 744) without checking whether the target is a platform admin or belongs to other projects.

Inserts a MapProjectMember(project_id=project_id, user_id=user.user_id) row for the matched user (or _import_workers at app/services/organization_service.py:2640 inserts a MasOrgUnitWorker row linked via resolve_user by UUID or email without calling require_on_project_roster).
Evaluates to True whenever the target user exists in MapProjectMember or MasOrgUnitWorker for project_id (lines 3967-3969), satisfying _roster_person (app/routes/admin_organization.py:1482).

Returns the target user's full email and phone, year_of_birth, age, sex, all live devices across all projects via list_account_devices(user.user_id) (line 1576), and unfiltered global AuthSecurityEvent history with actor names via _panel_activity (lines 1521-1541, 1591).

evidence.description: prepare_members resolves user = by_email or by_mobile and only rejects mismatches when both email and mobile are supplied on the row, allowing attachment of any active account knowing only one channel.

_import_workers calls create_worker and update_worker (line 2630) with user=row.get('user_email'), which calls resolve_user (lines 1816-1838) accepting a user_id UUID or email without enforcing require_on_project_roster (unlike admin_org_create_worker at app/routes/admin_organization.py:755 and admin_org_update_worker at line 860).

lookup_existing_user explicitly withholds the unqueried contact channel from non-admin callers, and _dm_user_json (app/routes/data_management.py:224-233) masks email and phone for out-of-reach users, both of which are bypassed once the user is attached to the roster.

_device_management_user requires a non-admin data manager to cover every live native-device-role grant on the target user across all projects before calling list_account_devices, whereas admin_project_user_panel (app/routes/admin_organization.py:1576) calls list_account_devices unconditionally for any user on the project roster.
_panel_activity queries AuthSecurityEvent by E.user_id == user_id across all projects without a project filter or exclusive-management check, joining VaUsers on actor_user_id to return actor.name.

validation_plan.local: Inside an approved isolated test database environment, seed two projects (PROJ_A and PROJ_B), an active user in PROJ_B (or a platform admin) with both email and mobile_login set, a live AuthDeviceSession in PROJ_B, and AuthSecurityEvent rows created by an actor in PROJ_B. Authenticate as a project_pi or project-scope data_manager of PROJ_A, upload a 1-row CSV containing only the target's email (or upload a workers CSV with the target's user_id UUID in user_email to POST /admin/api/organization/PROJ_A/import with dry_run=0), and then request GET /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<target_user_id> to observe the target's unqueried mobile number, demographics, PROJ_B device metadata, and PROJ_B security event log with actor names.
validation_plan.deployment: Review project_member_added security events in auth_security_events and worker links in mas_org_unit_worker in non-production/staging environments to verify whether non-admin project PIs or data managers have attached cross-project or admin accounts to their project rosters.
